remarks: Great opportunity to rent this newly painted, beautiful updated 1 Bedroom condominium with attached garage. Kitchen includes stainless steel appliances, a glass top stove, and gorgeous granite countertops. Additional features include a Dining Area which extends to a spacious Living Room with Sliders to a private Deck. Condo also includes Central Air, an attached Garage, a reserved Parking Space and a full size Washer & Dryer in the Basement. Conveniently located to Historic SoNo, Shopping, Schools, Nightlife and Hospital. Easy commuting with close proximity to The Metro North Train Station, I95 & The Merritt Parkway. Must have Very Good Credit and References.
